verdict.rationale: The only relevant evidence is a claim that AI agents get scoped permissions, data access, and approved actions managed from 'the same console that governs human users.' That implies an admin console governing human access, but it never describes view/edit roles for people. missing for 10: documentation of user/guest roles, project- or task-level view vs. edit permission controls, team/workspace permission settings, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
